o: Kelly Siegler and her team travel to small towns to dig into unsolved homicide cases that have lingered for years without answers or justice for the victims.

eps.o: Kelly and Steve head to his home state to unravel the murder of a recently married Navy veteran, shot execution-style in his lakeside home. An examination of phone records could hold the key to uncovering his killer's identity.
The Cold Justice team tackles the disappearance of a loving mother who allegedly disappeared during a family vacation. The investigation uncovers evidence that she never left town alive.

The "Cold Justice" team investigates the mysterious death of a pregnant mother whose skull was found on a wooded mountain; with multiple suspects and conflicting stories, can they uncover the truth and get justice for her and her unborn child?

Kelly and Steve team up with the Clinton County Sheriff's Office to solve the heartbreaking cold case of a young mother who vanished, leaving only her wedding rings behind; did she walk away, or was she murdered.

Kelly and Abbey investigate the 1999 murder of a beloved churchgoing mother and grandmother, shot dead in her own home. With no known enemies, was she killed to send a cruel message to someone she loved?

Kelly and Tonya look into the brutal murder of a hard-working mother who was stabbed and bludgeoned to death. The investigation uncovers a secret affair and a revelation as shocking as the murder itself.

Kelly and Steve join the Searcy Police Department to untangle the mystery of a popular hairstylist, murdered on the night of her thirtieth birthday; is it an old flame, a new boyfriend or someone else entirely?

Kelly and Steve investigate the mysterious murder of a devoted mother of four, found stabbed to death in her van with her wedding band on the floor. Was an alleged secret affair behind the shocking crime?
The team digs into the 1983 murder of a dedicated mother of six, stabbed in an apparent carjacking; clues at the scene hint that a dangerous man from her past may be responsible.

Kelly and Steve travel to Montana to investigate the famous case of a young Indigenous woman who vanished after a night out; analyzing surveillance video and her social media posts could finally bring justice to her community.
